verdict.tagline: Chaotic arcade brawling packed with unlockables and cooperative chaos.
for_you_if: you want a cooperative brawler to play with friends
you enjoy unlocking characters and mastering deep combat combos
not_for_you_if: you rely on active public matchmaking lobbies
you run into performance drops on specific hardware setups
you need a seamless menu experience without store redirects

citations.review_text: awesome game, the humor is awesome and the bosses are really unique, ost just makes the game even better, but do NOT do corn boss or do insane mode it will make you lose your mind and be the next guest to a asylum

I honestly don't know what to say. Given the reviews and the people who seemed to be having a blast, I was expecting something old-school but fun. Aside from a few silly moments meant for a laugh, the game is riddled with flaws. It might not be very entertaining solo, but everything, especially as you progress, becomes frustrating. Enemies just spam attacks, and the more of them there are, the worse it gets because they all spam at once. This makes it impossible to react or avoid taking massive damage, even if you do manage to win. The hitboxes on the rolling rocks and some attacks are questionable, too.. Huge, buff enemies are the most annoying, either you face them by spamming arrows and magic for 20 minutes, or they absolutely wreck you the moment you engage in melee combat and as soon as you defeat one, they throw another one at you right away.  I don't know, it just wasn't what I expected

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game features a combat system that is simple to learn while offering combos and depth for players to master.

citations.review_text: Though oftentimes crude and to the point, Castle Crashers is easily one of the most fun multiplayer experiences out there. A combat system anyone can pick up but only the dedicated will master, fun (and sometimes frustrating) bosses, and an extremely simple story all combine to make a game that you could play with just about anyone and enjoy. With incredible replay value hidden in its many character unlocks and weapons/pets to find, and an array of comedic designs across the entire game, it never got old for me.

Still one of the best couch co-op beat 'em ups around. The combat is simple to learn but has enough depth to keep things engaging, especially when leveling different characters. Packed with humor, memorable bosses, and chaotic multiplayer moments that somehow never get old.

citations.review_text: i like that you can beat the game to get more characters. Great replay value!

This game got me addicted after my friend gave me this and know I can't get off.The replay value of Castle Crashers is insane due to its simple yet fast gameplay and tons of characters to unlock.There is also a bunch of different move sets that can be discovered with every new character unlocked.So if I had to rate this game out of 10,I would give a 9.3.Definitely recommend.

It's very hard for me to get bored of this game. With many different characters to play, so many pets, and many weapons, there was so much to do. I could play this game hours on end. The multiplayer option also makes this an amazing game as it's a lot of fun to play with friends. This is an amazing multiplayer and solo game.

claims.claim: Reviewers describe the multiplayer experience with friends as a major highlight of the game.

citations.review_text: so many amazing and enjoyable memories have come from playing this masterpiece of a game with family and friends. could not recommend it more for playing with multiple people. while nothing can fully recreate playing it on someone else's 360 during a get together, you can still get pretty close. for such a simple and relatively short game, it's easily one of the most memorable ones i've played. check it out if you haven't, it's worth every cent. thanks behemoth for a great experience <3
really frickin' fun to play with friends

Castle Crashers is one of those games that's impossible not to have fun with. The combat is simple but satisfying, the humor never takes itself too seriously, and playing with friends makes the whole experience even better. It might not be the most complicated game out there, but its charm, replayability, and chaotic co-op are exactly what make it so memorable.
